Package neqsim.process.equipment.compressor

Class DryGasSealMonitor

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.compressor.DryGasSealMonitor
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class DryGasSealMonitor extends Object implements Serializable
Stateful advisory monitor for a tandem dry-gas-seal support system.

Supply-process differential pressure, primary vent, intermediate buffer gas and bearing-side separation gas are distinct measurements. All limits are caller supplied; this model does not infer an OEM failure diagnosis, issue plant commands or establish a safety-integrity level. Run one instance per seal and call it once per non-overlapping sample interval.

1.0

  • Method Details

    • evaluate

      public DryGasSealMonitor.Result evaluate(DryGasSealMonitor.Sample sample, double intervalSeconds)
      Evaluates one scan and advances continuous-fault timers. Invalid evidence is confirmed immediately; it cannot be interpreted as healthy or as confirmed physical seal damage. Other faults must persist for the configured delay. Recommendations latch until reset.
      Parameters:
      sample - sensor scan, or null for missing evidence
      intervalSeconds - duration represented by this scan, finite and positive
      Returns:
      detached advisory evidence
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the interval is nonfinite or nonpositive

    • reset

      public void reset()
      Resets all latched recommendations and timers; an active fault is detected on the next scan.

    • validSample

      private boolean validSample(DryGasSealMonitor.Sample sample)
      Checks sensor quality, physical ranges and freshness. A negative differential is a real barrier failure, whereas a negative absolute pressure or flow is invalid instrumentation.
      Parameters:
      sample - sensor scan
      Returns:
      true for complete valid evidence
